name: Iki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iki city emblem in purple, green and orange: a purple stylised swoosh with a green oval and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Iki, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2004.

features.role: Iki city emblem — a purple stylised swoosh with a green oval and an orange disc
